description: Edit, test, and build Unity projects with official tools.
longDescription: Use the official Unity CLI and Pipeline package for Editor control, scene changes, C# diagnostics, tests, and builds. Live Editor control requires Unity 6.0 LTS or later and a licensed Editor matching the project; the upstream CLI is experimental.
example.1: Check this Unity project's Editor version and official CLI readiness.
example.2: Add a rotating cube to a test scene, verify compilation, and run it in Unity.
